name: proton-pass
description: Use Proton Pass from the agent via the official pass-cli. Setup creates a vault-scoped agent token with browser approval and never prints it. After you approve each release, the agent can fill a login (including a short-lived 2FA code), read a TOTP code, create a login, or run a sandboxed program. Passwords, notes, TOTP seeds, and the agent token never come back.
